records.text: Owens said the October 10 explosion at Accurate Energetic Systems in Hickman County, Tennessee killed 16 employees.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: on October 10th, there was an explosion to the Accurate Energetic Systems, which they do make military and demolition explosives. ... This is about 60 miles west of Nashville, and like I said, killed 16 employees.

verification.notes: The U.S. Chemical Safety Board’s March 2026 investigation update states that multiple explosions at Accurate Energetic Systems on October 10, 2025 fatally injured all 16 employees inside Building 602.

sources.title: Accurate Energetic Systems Fatal Explosion
sources.relevance: Official U.S. Chemical Safety Board investigation page and update confirm the October 10, 2025 incident and 16 fatalities.

records.text: Owens said the Accurate Energetic Systems explosion could have resulted from an accident or could have been used to hide evidence.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, it could be because something went wrong, it's an explosives factory, or it could be a way to hide evidence. ... evidence that these are our two theories we don't know

records.text: Candace Owens said some theorists believed the rigged microphone device might have been assembled at Accurate Energetic Systems before its October 10 explosion.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: People believe that that could be where the device was assembled and I just need some time to flesh that out.
